fields.name: Home
fields.description: The main landing page for the website
fields.best_practices:
Include:
- A clear value proposition
- Overview of key services
- Trust signals (certifications, years in business)
- Easy navigation to other sections
- Contact information or call-to-action

fields.name: About Us
fields.description: Information about the practice and its history
fields.best_practices:
Include:
- Practice history and mission
- What makes you different
- Facility photos
- Community involvement
- Any certifications or accreditations

fields.name: Team
fields.best_practices:
For each team member, include:
- Professional headshot
- Full name and credentials (DVM, CVT, etc.)
- Role/title
- Brief bio (education, experience, specialties)
- Personal touch (pets, hobbies)

Tips:
- Keep bios consistent in length
- Use high-quality, well-lit photos
- Include all client-facing staff

fields.name: Services Overview
fields.best_practices:
Include:
- List of all major service categories
- Brief description of each
- Links to detailed service pages
- Any unique or specialized services
- Technology or equipment highlights

fields.name: Service Detail
fields.description: Detailed page for a specific service
fields.best_practices:
Include:
- What the service is and why it's important
- Who/what species it's for
- What to expect during the visit
- Benefits for the pet and owner
- Common FAQs about this service
- When to schedule/how often needed
- Related services

fields.name: FAQ
fields.best_practices:
Tips:
- Use actual questions clients ask
- Keep answers concise and clear
- Avoid medical jargon
- Group by category if you have many
- Include questions about:
  - Appointments and scheduling
  - Payment and insurance
  - Emergency procedures
  - New patient process
  - Common services

fields.name: Pricing
fields.best_practices:
Include:
- Exam fees
- Common procedure ranges
- Payment options accepted
- Financing information
- Insurance information

Note: You can list ranges rather than exact prices if preferred.

fields.name: Contact
fields.best_practices:
Include:
- Physical address with map
- Phone number(s)
- Email address
- Hours of operation (regular and holiday)
- Parking information
- Emergency/after-hours instructions
- Online booking link (if applicable)

fields.name: Forms
fields.best_practices:
Include:
- New patient registration form
- Medical history form
- Consent forms
- Instructions for completing forms

Provide existing PDFs or links to current forms.

fields.name: Resources
fields.description: Pet care resources and educational content
fields.best_practices:
Include:
- Pet care tips
- Seasonal health alerts
- Links to trusted resources
- Downloadable guides
- Video content if available

fields.name: Blog
fields.best_practices:
Best practices for blog content:
- Post regularly (at least monthly)
- Cover seasonal topics
- Answer common client questions
- Share practice news
- Use engaging images
